votes.motion: Enter executive session under MGL c. 30, s. 21(3) to discuss collective bargaining strategy and re-enter open session.
votes.quote: chair michael-ray jeffreys made a motion to enter into executive session and to re-enter open session after exiting executive session

votes.motion: Elect Caesar Nuzzolo as Chair (nomination by Member Moore).
votes.quote: call for the vote on member nuzzolo's nomination: three-aye; two-nay (members alonzo and emkey). the motion passed (3-2-0).

votes.motion: Elect Michael-Ray Jeffreys as Vice-Chair (nomination by Chair Nuzzolo).
votes.quote: call for the vote: three-aye; one-nay (member emkey); one-abstain (member alonzo). the motion passed (3-1-1).

votes.motion: Elect Amanda Moore as Clerk (nomination by Member Alonzo).
votes.quote: call for the vote: four-aye; one abstention (member emkey). the motion passed (4-0-1).

votes.motion: Revoke the license of The Re Boot (La Balena LLC) for failure to pay per the Sewer Commission agreement signed December 13, 2023.
votes.quote: member tom alonzo moved to revoke the license of the re boot under their failure to pay according to the agreement reached with the sewer commission signed december 13, 2023.

votes.motion: Find that Re Boot is in violation of its agreement to pay back taxes as agreed on December 13, 2023.
votes.quote: member alonzo moved that the board finds that re boot is in violation of their agreement of paying their back taxes as agreed to on december 13, 2023.

votes.motion: Rescind the alcohol license from Re Boot due to the violation.
votes.quote: member alonzo moved to rescind the alcohol license from re boot due to the violation.

votes.motion: Find Maxi Auto Inc. and Lunenburg Auto Center guilty of the violations presented by law enforcement.
votes.quote: member alonzo moved that the board find that the defendants, maxi auto inc., and lunenburg auto center, are guilty of the violations presented at this meeting by law enforcement.

votes.motion: Revoke all licenses issued to Maxi Auto Inc. and Lunenburg Auto Center; remove vehicles within seven days, remove signage, and cease sale or repair activity.
votes.quote: vice-chair jeffreys moved that the board revoke all licenses issued to maxi auto inc., and lunenburg auto center

votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager’s appointment of Logan O’Connell as Planning Board Administrative Assistant.
votes.quote: member emkey moved to ratify the town manager's appointment of logan o'connell as planning board administrative assistant.

votes.motion: Ratify the Town Manager’s appointment of Jamieson Snape as Seasonal Lifeguard.
votes.quote: vice-chair jeffreys moved to ratify the town manager's appointment of jamieson snape
clerk emkey made the motion to approve the minutes of june 4, 2024. seconded by member lehtinen.
jeffreys moved to adjourn. seconded by clerk moore.
